newsitem.title: USA: CBOT July soybeans hit fresh contract high.
newsitem.headline: CBOT July soybeans hit fresh contract high.

text.p: CBOT July soybean futures notched a fresh contract high and the May contract neared the $9.00 per bushel mark on renewed concerns that demand for soybeans was outpacing supply, traders said.
The new high for the July contract is $8.96 per bushel, topping the previous high of $8.95 set on Thursday and the highest level since August 1988 when a drought devastated the soybean crop.

The May contract also posted a fresh contract high and came within 1-1/2 cents of $9.00 per bushel. While that level was well below the double-digit levels hit at the peak of the 1988 drought rally, floor sources said it was still a milestone.
Profit taking cropped up just above the contract highs. Massive profit taking after Thursday's gains dropped soybeans to the day's lows.
At 1135 CDT, soybeans were up 15 to five cents per bushel with July up 15 at $8.92 a bushel.
